say:3:1041217001:1.text: No matter how many times I see it, Kafra's sword just looks intimidating...
say:3:1041217001:1.source_cn: 无论看到多少次，卡夫拉这把大剑的威慑力还是很强……

say:4:1041217002:1.text: Do not be deceived by its appearance. This sword is slender and light. I could wield it with a single hand. If it was in your hands, you would be unstoppable!
say:4:1041217002:1.source_cn: 不可被外表欺骗，此剑纤薄轻盈，吾尚可单手挥动，汝等必定...

say:5:1041217003:1.text: But that's only true for you, Kafra. I don't believe Lyca could manage it.
say:5:1041217003:1.source_cn: ……卡夫拉，那只是对你来说。莱卡拿不起来的。

say:6:1041217004:1.text: Aside from you, no other member of the Thorned Guards could wield it.
say:6:1041217004:1.source_cn: 除你之外，也没有第二个荆棘队员能运用了。
